import itertools

def find_strings(h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34):
    # Calculate the possible lengths based on the given Hamming distances
    # The maximum possible length is the sum of the largest Hamming distances
    max_length = max(h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34)
    
    # Try all possible lengths from 1 to max_length
    for length in range(1, max_length + 1):
        # Generate all possible strings of the current length
        possible_strings = ['a' * length, 'b' * length]
        for i in range(2, length + 1):
            possible_strings += ['a' * (length - i) + 'b' * i, 'b' * (length - i) + 'a' * i]
        
        # Check all combinations of the four strings
        for s1, s2, s3, s4 in itertools.permutations(possible_strings, 4):
            if (hamming(s1, s2) == h12 and
                hamming(s1, s3) == h13 and
                hamming(s1, s4) == h14 and
                hamming(s2, s3) == h23 and
                hamming(s2, s4) == h24 and
                hamming(s3, s4) == h34):
                return length, s1, s2, s3, s4
    
    return -1, None, None, None, None

def hamming(s1, s2):
